compliance_fields.cooling_off_terms: Borrower may exit the loan within the cooling-off period by repaying principal and proportionate interest, without penalty.
compliance_fields.penal_charges: Penal charges shall be levied as per RBI Circular on Penal Charges dated August 18, 2023. These are excluded from APR calculation.
compliance_fields.prepayment_terms: No prepayment penalty on floating rate loans for individual borrowers.
compliance_fields.grievance_redressal: Contact SBI Customer Care: 1800-11-2211 (Toll Free) or visit nearest branch.

borrower_acknowledgment.text: I/We acknowledge that I/We have read and understood the Key Fact Statement and the terms of the loan. I/We confirm that the information provided herein has been explained to me/us in a language I/we understand.
